components.description: Paid parental leave of up to three weeks at full pay on becoming a parent (birth, adoption, foster placement, or guardianship of a child under seven), for tenured, tenure-track and longer-term non-tenure-track faculty; offered as one of two options (the other is six weeks at half pay).
components.faculty_group_note: A faculty member who is tenured or tenure-track or who is non-tenure-track with an appointment of one year or more (HRM-038, Applies To: Academic Division)
eligible_parent: any_parent
components.eligible_parent_wording: upon becoming a parent, either through the birth of a child or through the adoption, placement of a foster child, or assumption of legal guardianship for a child under seven years of age
components.entitlement_note: 'may request' with no grant language; Parental Leave sits under Section 2 'Leave for Personal Reasons', whose opening paragraph states that such leave 'may be approved at the discretion of' the supervisor and dean and 'Such approval is not guaranteed' (V2; source precedence: the section statement governs the subsection).
components.duration_note: Option of 'up to three weeks of leave with full pay or six weeks of leave at half-pay' (in_lieu_of c2), in HRM-038 as captured 2017-12-23, which governs on the reference date 2018-01-01; that version has no intermittent-use sentence. Extensions beyond a leave category's limits need approval of the executive vice president or president in the best interests of the University (Procedures).
components.relief_note: Leave of absence; no relief stated, so every duty relieved (R9).
components.time_window: must be completed within twelve months of the date of the birth or placement of the child
components.dual_employee_rule: No more than two faculty members may be approved for parental leave related to the same event; faculty parents in the same unit may be required to stagger or coordinate paid and unpaid parental leave

sequence.note: option of three weeks at full pay or six weeks at half pay (R15b: link on each option)

notes: Reference date 2018-01-01. The record was first read as of the original 2018 coding date (2019-01-28); where the policy in force on 2018-01-01 differs, the record follows that policy: HRM-038 as revised 1/4/17 (2018_20) for the parental leave (c1-c3), and the modified duties of the 2019 text (c4) are flagged not_yet_effective (V5).

Sources: 2018_02 HRM-038 rev. 1/9/19; 2018_03 PROV-017; 2018_04 HRM-026; 2018_05 Provost short-term disability page; 2018_06 UVA HR disability benefits; 2018_07 DHRM Policy 4.21; 2018_20 HRM-038 (2017 text).

Governing documents: HRM-038 Faculty Leaves as revised 1/4/17 (2018_20, captured 2017-12-23), in force on the reference date, for the parental leave (c1-c3); and HRM-038 as revised 1/9/19 (2018_02), the only saved copy of the later text (a 2019-09-15 capture headed 'Last Revised: 04/17/2019', revision history 'Updated links 4/17/19; Revised 1/9/19'), for the other leaves, whose components citing it are flagged version_uncertain.

2018_20 is HRM-038 as revised 1/4/17 (capture 2017-12-23), the version in force on the reference date 2018-01-01. Its parental leave was 'up to three weeks of leave with full pay or six weeks of leave at half-pay' (child under seven for guardianship), plus 'an additional nine weeks of unpaid parental leave'; it had no Modified Duties section and no intermittent-use sentence. Differences between 2018_20 and 2018_02: header/menu lines; Last Revised date; Modified Duties added to the table of contents and as a section; sabbatical definition ('periodic' dropped); 'Some may be taken' -> 'Other types may be taken'; partial-pay threshold wording; probationary-period sentence reworded as 'clock-stoppage'; benefits-counselor sentence; 'Schools and units may have specific procedures or more restrictive policies' dropped; Section 2.E -> 2.F references; UHR -> UVA HR; parental leave paragraph (3/6 weeks -> 8/16 weeks; guardianship age 7 -> 18; 'thesame qualifying parental leave event'); unpaid 9 weeks -> 4 weeks for those taking paid leave; intermittent use and 'every effort to accommodate' sentences added; disability section adds the VRS/ORP sentence and HR page link; annual-leave table reformatted; jury-duty pronoun; procedures and related-information links.

HRM-038's general statements govern every leave in it: faculty must request leave and obtain approvals; 'A leave request will be considered in light of the faculty member's particular situation and the needs of the faculty member's department or unit'; leave for personal reasons (Family, Parental, Other Personal, and Modified Duties in Section 2) 'may be approved at the discretion of the faculty member's supervisor and dean or vice president. Such approval is not guaranteed.' Hence the parental leave is coded discretionary.

Disability path (U8): HRM-038 says disability benefits are determined by the retirement plan (VRS or ORP). The ORP path (The Standard; for faculty: immediate eligibility, 100% of salary for up to 180 calendar days, no waiting period; LTD 66.66%) is coded as c11-c13. Not coded, VRS path: VSDP short-term disability up to 125 workdays; for a member hired on or after 1 July 2009 coverage begins after one year, and with 13-59 months of state service income replacement is 125 workdays at 60% (with fewer than 60 months, hired before 1 July 2009: 5 days at 100%, 20 at 80%, 100 at 60%); LTD 60%. HRM-026: leave managed through VSDP's carrier is automatically deemed FMLA leave.

Other groups' disability plans described but not coded as components (not faculty, generic plans): ORP short-term disability for staff (five-day waiting period, 100% for 25 workdays, 80% through day 180); MCRP members (UNUM, 60% weekly up to $1,100 from day 15; LTD 60%); housestaff LTD (70%, 90-day elimination).

DHRM Policy 4.21 (c15) applies to positions covered by the Virginia Personnel Act; Va. Code 2.2-2905(8) (saved statute) exempts 'The presidents and teaching and research staffs of state educational institutions', so it does not cover UVA tenure-stream faculty; recorded with its group. Effective June 26, 2018, after the reference date (flagged not_yet_effective, V5).

Other HRM-038 leaves read and not coded (a parent could not use them for a birth or adoption, or they are professional): sabbatical, educational leave, military duty leave, conversion leave, jury duty. Sick days below the short-term disability threshold are 'managed between the employee and his or her supervisor' (no balance stated). A leave of absence is not granted for longer than two consecutive years except in exceptional circumstances; extensions need executive approval in the best interests of the University (not a per-event cap; leave_limits left empty).

Provost page: after short-term disability, 'Accommodations can be made regarding release time, a partial return to work, working from an alternate location, or using your annual leave, as long as these accommodations are consistently applied regardless of the reason for the absence' (departmental discretion for any absence; not a parental provision, not coded). The ORP plan also allows part-time disability (part of c12).

Cross-references cited but not saved: school-specific modified duties policies; The Standard Disability Group Certificate, Group Certificate Amendment and plan document; 'The Standard Disability at a Glance'; UHR Guidelines for Requesting Family, Medical, or Military Leave; PROV-009 Faculty Holding Appointments at Other Institutions; VSDP Handbook; MCRP short- and long-term disability summaries and booklets; Medical Center Policy 600 (Leaves of Absence); DHRM Policies 2.20, 4.10, 4.20, 4.30, 4.55, 4.57; Executive Order #12 (2018); each school's sabbatical policy.

Calendar: the documents use semesters ('one semester at full salary or two semesters at half salary'; 'a semester in which they take leave'; 'semester breaks') without a length, so term_weeks is the semester default 16 (R8).

Birth parent chain: short-term disability leave c11 up to 180 calendar days (ORP pay c12 at 100% within it) -> paid parental leave c1 3 weeks at full pay (or c2 6 weeks at half pay, in_lieu_of) 'in addition to' the disability leave (also_available) -> unpaid parental leave c3 9 weeks (also_available); FMLA c14 concurrent_with from the start of c11; modified duties c4 (general_purpose) relief in the semester of the leave, unlinked.

Non-birth parent chain: paid parental leave c1 3 weeks at full pay (or c2 6 weeks at half pay, in_lieu_of) -> unpaid parental leave c3 9 weeks (also_available); FMLA c14 concurrent_with from the start of c1; c11/c12 do not apply (HR: paternity 'does not fall under the short term disability plan').
